long_biography.plain_text:
Pangputhipong Selby captained Thailand's first complete team at the 2009 FCI World Championships, with her husband, Michael Selby, serving as second captain. Specialist handlers competed with Malinois and German shepherds, supported by private and institutional sponsors. The assignment placed her at the centre of Thailand's first full national entry.

Dogs remained a defining personal interest. Selby has maintained a household of dozens of them and appeared at agility and animal-welfare events, including a Bangkok gathering with her Jagdterrier. Her collections include Oriental art, antique furniture and textiles acquired during travel.
